title: Mizzen build diagnostic report
description: `.mizzen/build-report.json`: a versioned record of what a build read, how it was configured, which tools and environment produced it, and which publishable files it wrote. Paths are relative so moving a checkout changes nothing.

format.description: The report format. Only 1 exists; Mizzen 0.2.5 reads it.

categories.description: The categories two reports are compared by, in order. A record with any other list is refused rather than compared by a rule this version does not know.

inputs.description: Every declared input the build read: the lock files, the local data sources, and the discovered content files.

lock.description: The primary data lock, when one exists.

path.description: The lock file, relative to the site root.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the lock file's bytes.

locks.description: Every lock file present, by path relative to the site root.

data.description: Every local collection source, by path relative to the site root. A remote source is identified by its lock entry instead.

content.description: Every discovered page, asset, data file, and template, by path relative to the source folder.

config.description: The effective configuration: one hash of every resolved value, the reference date, output switches, and SHA-256 fingerprints of the rules that shape output. No rule value is written.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical resolved config.

referenceDate.description: The site's effective as-of date, which a query or output may compare dates with.

rules.description: Rule-bearing configuration with sensitive values removed: defaults name only their keys; collection and quality rules and redirect destinations are SHA-256 fingerprints. Output switches and feed and calendar names are listed.

defaults.description: Front-matter defaults by folder, with the keys they set and not their values.

redirects.description: Redirect map from an old path to the SHA-256 fingerprint of its destination.

collections.description: Per-collection SHA-256 fingerprints of transforms and derived rules, plus the configured reference date.

quality.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the configured data-quality rules, exceptions, and policy, when the site declares them.

tools.description: The actual versions that produced the build.

theme.description: The theme or renderer, from its package metadata; a folder without one is `custom` with an empty version.

version.description: The theme package version, empty when it names none.

environment.description: Environment values that can change output.

sourceDateEpoch.description: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, when set; an output may read it.

outputs.description: Every publishable file and one hash of the build, with the manifest and platform metadata left out as `mizzen verify` leaves them out.

hash.description: SHA-256 of one line per file, paths sorted by code point.

files.description: SHA-256 of each file, by path relative to the output folder.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

fileMap.description: A path-to-SHA-256 map. A path is relative with `/` separators and cannot leave its root.
